{{Quote|You may have me outnumbered and outgunned, but if I'm going down, I'm taking all of you with me. This thermal detonator will blow us all to bits.|[[Calo Nord]]|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''thermal detonator''', also known as a '''thermal grenade''', was a highly unstable [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]-like weapon popular among [[Army/Legends|military personnel]], criminals, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. The thermal detonator was utilized since at least as early as [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|It's a thermal detonator. [&hellip;] If you let go without disarming the deadman's switch first, it goes off.''"<br />"''And does what, exactly?''"<br />"''Makes a small thermonuclear fusion reaction.''"<br />"''A small thermonuclear fusion reaction.''"<br />"''Yeah, just enough to vaporize a good-size chunk of whatever is next to it.|[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="SOTE N">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The thermal detonator was designed to be thrown by the user, planted in a specific location or on a specific vessel, or dropped by a vehicle. It would then adhere to any metallic object until it detonated. The reasons for using a thermal detonator varied widely, and despite the legal restrictions of many governments, the thermal detonator saw widespread use across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[File:Thermal_Detonator.jpg|thumb|left|A thermal detonator]]
The name was descriptive of the process by which the device exploded. Inside the shell, which was generally made of [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]] or [[axidite]], was a sample of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]], a highly volatile substance. A trigger emitted a short burst of energy that forced the baradium into a state of fusion reaction. This trigger could simply be a button. Some had a fail-deadly trigger, meaning that if it was released, it would set off the grenade. Once activated, the user could reset the grenade to its safe position, thus disarming it before it detonated.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

The result of the explosion was an expanding particle field that could atomize any material that did not conduct heat or thermal energy within the fixed blast radius&mdash;typically five to six<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> [[Meter/Legends|meters]], though specific grenades could have a blast up to 100 meters.<ref name="WT" /> Unlike other grenades, a thermal detonator's blast would only go as far as its blast radius. After that, the blast field would collapse, and anything even slightly beyond the blast radius would be left unharmed.

Most thermal detonators had fixed field yields and radiation burst yields, along with timers. Some, such as those used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], featured adjustable timers, with settings typically ranging from six to eighteen seconds.

===Variants===
[[File:StormtrooperThermalDetonator-TCVD.jpg|thumb|220px|[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] thermal detonator]]
*[[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|Class-A thermal detonator]], an extremely powerful military model
*[[Class-C thermal detonator]], a military model
*Merr-Sonn Munitions [[V-1 thermal detonator]], a smaller model designed for battlefield use
*[[Baradium-core code key thermal detonator]], special operations model
*[[Thermal detonator tape]], used for breaching sealed doors
*[[MM-40 thermal charge]]

The different types of thermal detonators varied in power greatly. Although typically used as a grenade, many were far deadlier.

===Usage===
{{Quote|Little sphere, big boom.|Unknown Rebel [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]]|<ref name="EOW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Cad_Bane_thermal_detonator.jpg|thumb|left|300px|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] tosses a thermal detonator into a room of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]]]]
For use as thrown explosives, thermal detonators used a thumb-operated trigger and a timed detonator to ensure the weapon bearer did not destroy himself. When used by a soldier, the trigger was pressed and the device was then lobbed towards the enemy. It had to be timed, so it couldn't be thrown back, or detonate in midair. When used as gravity or inertial explosives by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], or mortar units, thermal detonators used a range sensor to determine the appropriate trigger time. Some could even be clamped onto things, such as speeders. Thermal detonators were sometimes used as mining tools, but other devices were better suited for the job.

Some people connected several thermal detonators using a linking mechanism, which would allow them to detonate at once and increase the damage.<ref name="MW">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}</ref>

Small thermal detonators could be inserted in a victim's body and set to explode when an external condition was met. In that case, the victim would die in the explosion, but bystanders would not be harmed.<ref name="ARv">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: Revelation and Refutation}}</ref>

The explosive charge could be removed from a thermal detonator and replaced with a small ion charge, effectively becoming an [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]].<ref name="AoT">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Army of Terror]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Because he's holding a thermal detonator!|C-3PO, translating for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
[[File:Change_of_Plan-BotF.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Leia Organa disguised as Boushh, armed with a thermal detonator]]
By the late days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], thermal detonators had become very common and more practical than the aging [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]] and the [[Plasma grenade/Legends|plasma grenade]], despite the fact that the Republic had outlawed them. Ironically, the Republic would use them in [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|its army]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] also used thermal detonators, though not as often, during the Clone Wars. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] carried them on their belts not only to intimidate, but to use. Stormtroopers and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel soldiers]] both employed thermal detonators during the entire [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Elite stormtroopers known as [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm commandos]] carried thermal detonators.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

While disguised as [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] bounty hunter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] threatened to use a thermal detonator during her encounter with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in a [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|plan to rescue]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Models of thermal detonators first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The weapon was first identified by name in {{Film|VI}}.<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi" /> Their use spans from ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.
